trickyParts: Census files 0117 and 0118 answer select 0, not the row counts the plan named: a non-zero census refuses the deploy (cmd/dispatch/README.md 'Pre-deploy census'), and neither migration loses or rewrites a value anything reads.

Azure answers HTTP 500 to an empty input (INFRA-399's tester) and every new issue's spec is an empty document: scanPending settles a text with no non-space character with no model call, the coverage pass settles such a row left dead, and coverage counts only items with text to embed. repairStale still reaches an item whose text became empty with triggers off, so its old vector goes.

The meaning candidate CTEs now order by the bound $9::vector instead of q.qvec: the old form never used the HNSW index (the old index test ran copied SQL); search_index_test.go now explains the real statement and asserts embeddings_cosine filtered on model.

The coverage pass takes no lease; every step is idempotent and safe beside another process's pass (two concurrent passes tested). Two processes configured with different embedders keep dropping each other's vectors, which the docs state.
Live proof ran keyless only: local auth is off on the Azure resource, so the key form is proven by httptest tests alone (as INFRA-393's planner directed).
deviations: Plan Decision 10 named census counts; the censuses answer 0 (above).
Plan Decision 8 extended: texts with nothing to embed are settled, not embedded (the INFRA-399 500 finding; the planner proposed this shape on 2026-10-25).
search.go's candidates use the bound vector directly to reach the HNSW index (beyond the plan's filter-only change).
discoveredComplexity: Inputs over about 125,580 tokens are cut silently by the Azure deployment; maxInputChars (32,000 runes, about 7,200 tokens measured) keeps every request far below that.
